html.change: Only the SHA-384 integrity attribute of the .wasm preload link is replaced with the digest of the patched .wasm.

blocks.name: title-bar Discord control
blocks.effect: The width check that decides whether to draw the title-bar Discord button is replaced by the constant i32.const 1 (rest of the 12 bytes become nop), so the button's block is always skipped.

blocks.name: welcome screen promotion
blocks.effect: The stack-balanced instruction block that adds spacing, draws the Discord button (and drops its Response) and draws the project link row on the start screen is replaced entirely with nop.

blocks.name: About window promotion
blocks.effect: The equivalent block in the About window (Discord button and project link row) is replaced entirely with nop.
